title: fab-test.yml
description: Configuration schema for fab-test.yml, the optional config-file front door for the fab-test CLI. Every setting is optional; an absent key falls back to its environment variable (where one exists) and then its packaged default.

artifact_dir.description: Root directory to discover artifacts (default: fabric-artifacts, or the repository root for `fab-test local`).

output_dir.description: Root directory for result envelopes and the run manifest (default: fab-test-results).

jobs.description: Number of artifacts to run in parallel for the same analyzer (default: 1).

format.description: Output format for aggregate summaries (default: text).

timeout.description: Per-artifact subprocess timeout in seconds [env: ANALYZER_TIMEOUT] (default: 200). Setting this overrides fab-test's own case-count-scaled timeout for playwright, which otherwise raises the ceiling for a report with a large page/bookmark/role matrix instead of using this flat number.

verbosity.description: How much a run prints when no -q/-v flag is passed [env: ANALYZER_VERBOSITY] (default: default). `summary` is -q (one line per artifact); `verbose` and `debug` are -v and -vv.

environment.description: Default environment label, e.g. DEV/PROD/ANY [env: FABRIC_ENVIRONMENT].

report.description: Write a readable HTML report beside each result envelope. Opt-in; false unless set. PBIR Inspector's own TestRun.html is unaffected and appears regardless.

open_report.description: Open the produced report/index in the default browser after the run. Opt-in; implies report generation; suppressed under CI (GITHUB_ACTIONS or CI set).

workspace.description: Default Fabric workspace for targets that name an artifact but not a workspace. A display name or a GUID [env: FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID]; a positional WORKSPACE.Workspace/NAME.Type target overrides it.

interactive_auth.description: Feature flag for --interactive browser sign-in in service mode. Default on; off refuses --interactive with exit 2 [env: FAB_TEST_INTERACTIVE_AUTH=0 also disables]. Never prompts in CI.

rules.description: Rule overlays: deltas applied to a packaged ruleset instead of forking it.

telemetry.description: Where analyzer telemetry is sent. Configuring a complete destination is what enables shipping -- there is no separate on switch. --no-telemetry still refuses, --telemetry still forces, and ENABLE_EVENTHOUSE_LOGGING still applies.

eventhouse.description: Fabric Eventhouse ingest destination. Requires the [telemetry] extra (pip install cft-fab-test[telemetry]) and a service principal granted the Database Ingestor role on the KQL database.

database.description: KQL database holding the telemetry tables [env: EVENTHOUSE_DATABASE]. The table itself is derived from the analyzer and is not configurable.

lakehouse.description: Fabric Lakehouse ingest destination via OneLake. Requires the [telemetry-lakehouse] extra (pip install cft-fab-test[telemetry-lakehouse]) and a service principal with write access to the Lakehouse.

workspace.description: Workspace name or GUID holding the Lakehouse [env: LAKEHOUSE_WORKSPACE].

lakehouse.description: Lakehouse name [env: LAKEHOUSE_NAME]. Telemetry lands under Files/fab-test-telemetry/<table>/ as JSONL, one file per run.

playwright_config.description: Optional local or Azure browser execution YAML, relative to this config file [env: PLAYWRIGHT_CONFIG_PATH]; --playwright-config wins.

playwright_user_name.description: Effective-identity user (UPN) embedded in the RLS token `fab-test playwright` mints [env: PLAYWRIGHT_USER_NAME, which wins]. Only used for cases that carry a role.

disable.description: Rule IDs to remove from the effective ruleset.

extend.description: Path to a JSON file of additional rules to append.
